supersededOrFailedEvidence.reason: v18.2 completed-release checkpoints had not yet advanced to v18.3.
http_api.go exceeded the permanent 1200-line responsibility budget; corrected by behavior-preserving HTTP health ownership split.
v18_2_renderer_test.js incorrectly owned the current release title; replaced with a version-neutral canonical DE.PULSE title sanity check.
Hosted runtime environment variables were initially scoped too broadly; corrected to apply only to the launched hosted server. Immutable source unchanged.

Initial Stable native jobs duplicated G12 Smart Router/Rapid Move active-state assertions; Windows also exposed UTF-8 and POSIX permission-mode harness assumptions. Corrected G14-only retry passed on unchanged Stable source.

aiplcLessons: Inherited release-specific regression harnesses must not own current release identity; canonical identity/version gates own it.
Hosted runtime environment variables must be scoped to hosted launch and must not contaminate neutral PostgreSQL test/build steps.
Canonical source fingerprints must be taken from the actual Git transformation/source bytes, not an independently reconstructed equivalent.
Markdown-aware formatting policy is required; generic whitespace checks must not reject intentional Markdown hard breaks.
Native G14 validates actual packaged-runtime responsibilities and must not duplicate Smart Router/Rapid Move active-state behavior already certified by G12.
Windows native audits must force UTF-8 for UTF-8 repository documents and must not treat POSIX permission bits as the Windows security contract.
Tooling-only release branches/scripts must never mutate immutable RC/Stable source identity.
One-shot patch/build staging must represent new files correctly and bind integrity to repository Git blob/source identity.
Checkpoint/evidence-only commits remain fingerprint-excluded and occur after immutable Stable source/tag freeze.
